title: Group the terms
text: The signs repeat every three terms, so the series equals $$x-x^2-x^3$$ times the geometric series with first term $$1$$ and ratio $$x^3$$.

title: Sum the geometric series
text: That geometric series sums to $$\frac{1}{1-x^3}$$, so the answer is $$\frac{x-x^2-x^3}{1-x^3}$$.
